species.real: William McGonagall's poem The Tay Bridge Disaster is often called one of the worst in the English language, and is still read aloud for exactly that reason.
species.name: Taywraith

dex.text: On wild winter nights a train's lamps are seen crossing the Tay where no rails have run since 1879. It never reaches the other side, and it never stops trying. It is not angry. It would just like to get home.
dex.fact: The first Tay Bridge fell in a storm on 28 December 1879 as a train crossed it, and nobody aboard survived; around 75 people are usually said to have died. Dundonians told of a ghost train seen crossing on the anniversary.
